sloka: जटायुषो वधं श्रुत्वा दुःखितः सो ऽरुणात्मजः ।त्वां शशंस वरारोहे वसन्तीं रावणालये ।। ५.३५.६६।।।।
transliteration: jaṭāyuṣo vadhaṁ śrutvā duḥkhitaḥ so 'ruṇātmajaḥ ।tvāṁ śaśaṁsa varārohe vasantīṁ rāvaṇālaye ।। 5.35.66।।।।

translations.english: "Having heard about the death of Jatayu, O charming lady that Sampati Aruna's son felt sad and told us that you are at Ravana's palace.
